QuestInfo.name: Road to Treglow
QuestInfo.0: #b#p3001100##k will tell you what to do once inside #bTyrant's Castle#k. Go see #b#p3001100##k.
QuestInfo.1: Eliminate 100 #r#o2400118##k monsters at the #m401052000# and obtain 40 #b#t4000737##k items from their heads.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated Treglow's creations. Receive the next mission from #b#p3001100##k.

0.0: Welcome back, Kaiser. You look more determined than usual...
0.1: I've decided that #rTreglow#k's laboratory is our next target. #rVictor#k and #rTreglow#k are relatively equally matched, but #rTreglow#k has far more important information in his files.
0.2: Go through the #b#m401050000##k to the #b#m401052000##k. According to #b#p3001107##k's troops, the path to #bTreglow#k is being guarded by chemically-altered beasts.
0.3: Keep quiet for now, but it would be smart to clear out some of #rTreglow#k's creations, like the #r#o2400118##k monsters. Also, bring me any #b#t4000737##k items you find. They might be helpful.

yes.0: Return to me with the flasks this time, but our future communications would be better suited to the #bD-02 Receiver#k.

no.0: Please talk to me again once you're ready.

0.msg: Please bring back #b40 #t4000737##k items. I don't think you have enough just yet.
They had these stuck on their heads? #rTreglow#k always was an odd duck. I would have put a flower on their heads. At least it would make the lab more lively.

1.msg: I'll start chopping these horrendous things up to see what I can find. Let me know when you are ready for your next task.
